changes: Already-aborted operations fail CANCELLED before workflow creation. Cancellation is rechecked after asynchronous creation, immediately before provider callbacks, after extraction and before accepting final results.

finalFocusedRegressions.command: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern='already stopped|asynchronous workflow creation|traced stage|never cacheable' test/reader.test.js
